additionalRules: A Lurtz's Scouts Army must always contain Lurtz, who is always the Army's General.

specialRules.name: Relentless March
specialRules.text: Friendly models increase their Move Value to 8". Additionally, friendly models gain the Woodland Creature special rule.

specialRules.name: "You do not know pain, you do not know fear"
specialRules.text: The Break Point for Lurtz's Scouts is 66% rather than 50%.

specialRules.name: "Kill the others"
specialRules.text: Lurtz gains the General Hunter special rule and may declare a Heroic Combat each turn for free.

specialRules.name: Find the Halflings
specialRules.text: In Scenarios that use the Maelstrom of Battle special rule, Lurtz's Warband does not roll to determine where they arrive. Instead, Lurtz may choose the result.

specialRules.name: Shield Throw
specialRules.text: If Lurtz has been equipped with a shield, then once per game Lurtz can use it as a throwing weapon and may re-roll the To Hit Roll. This has a Strength of 4 and any model on a 25mm base that is hit will immediately be knocked Prone. Once Lurtz has thrown his shield, he no longer carries it; though Lurtz's Defence will not be reduced as a result.

specialRules.name: Oblivious to Pain
specialRules.text: Whenever Lurtz suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On the roll of a natural 6, the Wound is ignored.

specialRules.name: Unhinged Charge
specialRules.text: At the start of a Combat in which Mauhur Charged, Mauhur may declare he is using this special rule before any dice are rolled. If he does, then he suffers a -1 penalty to his Duel Rolls; however, if his side wins, he may re-roll any failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes in that Combat.

specialRules.name: Head Taker
specialRules.text: Should Ugluk's Army be Broken, then at the start of his Activation, instead of taking his Courage Test Ugluk can choose to kill a friendly Warrior model within 2" of him; remove the killed model as a casualty. If he does, then Ugluk will automatically pass his Courage Test, and his Stand Fast will be increased to 12" and will affect both Hero and Warrior models.

specialRules.name: "Looks like meat's back on the menu, boys!"
specialRules.text: At the start of his Activation, Ugluk can kill a friendly Orc Warrior within 2" of him; remove the killed model as a casualty. If Ugluk does this, then all friendly Uruk-hai models within 6" of him gain the Fearless special rule and gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes until the end of the turn. If Ugluk does this in a turn in which his Army is Broken, then it will also count as triggering the Head Taker rule above.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader. They may, however, be included in another Hero model's warband as one of their followers.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Lurtz's Scouts army-list page. Full stat blocks from the Isengard faction page, except Mauhur, whose stat block is published on the Evil Legacy page.
